entry.title: Fault-Tolerant Logical Magic-State Distillation on Bivariate Bicycle Quantum LDPC Codes
entry.summary:
Surface codes require over $1{,}000$ physical qubits per logical qubit at realistic gate error rates $p \approx 10^{-3}$. We demonstrate a constant-depth magic-state factory directly on high-rate bivariate bicycle qLDPC codes ($[[144, 12, 12]]$), achieving logical $T$-gate infidelity below $10^{-9}$ with $6.8\times$ fewer physical qubits than planar lattice surgery.

Source: arXiv Quantum Physics (quant-ph) · Tags: #quantum-computing #quantum-physics

entry.title: Fractional Quantum Anomalous Hall Superconductivity in Rhombohedral Pentalayer Graphene
entry.summary:
Coexistence of fractional Chern insulator states and unconventional superconductivity at zero magnetic field has remained elusive in moiré heterostructures. Transport spectroscopy in hBN-aligned rhombohedral pentalayer graphene reveals a dissipationless superconducting dome emerging directly out of a $\nu = -2/3$ fractional topological state below $T_c = 380\text{ mK}$.

Source: APS Physical Review Letters · Tags: #condensed-matter #quantum-physics

entry.title: Conformal Bootstrap Bounds on Graviton Scattering Amplitudes in $\text{AdS}_5 \times S^5$
entry.summary:
Non-perturbative stringy corrections to supergravity amplitudes at finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ are constrained by dispersion relations and crossing symmetry. Combining numerical conformal bootstrap with localization inputs, we pin down the first three higher-derivative Wilson coefficients to within $0.04\%$ across all couplings.

Source: arXiv High-Energy Theory (hep-th) · Tags: #high-energy #quantum-physics
